name: pdf-specialist
description: An all-in-one plugin for the pdf-specialist subagent: auditing, verifying, producing and looking up the specification for PDFs. Declares the four PDF Family MCP servers and the pdf-trust / pdf-publish Skills as dependencies, so one install brings the whole set. Verdicts come from evaluate_policy (a deterministic rule engine) and veraPDF; the agent orchestrates and explains, and never overrides them.
